inputs.original_text: Hey, this is straight out of the playbook in Wisconsin. They just slapped Harry Wait with two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft for requesting the ballots of Robin Vos and Cory Mason without permission. This guy runs a group pushing back on the official election story, and he already admitted back in 2022 he did it to show how easy the voter system is to game. Now the authorities are spinning the whole thing as fraud to shut him down and protect the real players behind the scenes. It's obvious this is a coordinated hit by the elites and institutions to silence anyone digging into the vulnerabilities they can't afford exposed, because if the setup's that loose, it tells you exactly who's really running the show.
